candidate_universe: All nonmandatory tokens in actual common document source, including tokens outside independent initial union.
objective: F(U)=sum_r:tau_r>0 min(g_r(U)/tau_r,1)+min(|U|/max_r(k_r),1), omitting cardinality term only if max k is zero; g_r is weighted top-k rank; tau=(1-epsilon)*original_exact_binary_score_sum-fixed_exact_binary_score_sum.
normalization: Each request normalized by its own positive tau. Unit token cost. Exact integer arithmetic on original binary score values and decimal rational epsilon, with common denominator for all normalized marginal terms. No float lazy-bound approximation.
selection: Start empty; add maximal exact marginal gain token; smallest original token ID breaks exact ties. Lazy old marginals are exact upper bounds. No order or arm selection; one deterministic full-universe arm.
refill: At stopping, independently choose stable top-k within U for each request, then mandatory tokens. Score ties use smaller token ID. Remove unused U from reported final union. No reverse-delete pass.
stopping_and_feasibility: All exact rational tau and cardinality conditions pass; final original math.fsum loss and loss/original both must satisfy original float epsilon bound. If rare boundary rounding fails, preserve failure and do not relax epsilon.
zero_epsilon: Original independent supports returned unchanged, identity control rather than greedy recomputation.
order: source order as frozen below, budget ascending, KV head ascending, epsilon ascending. Any time limit retains this predetermined prefix of completed cells, never selected by observed result.

checks: lazy chosen sequence and exact marginal equal complete recomputation greedy
exact exhaustive feasible-U optimum bounds final union
mandatory/private and exact budgets plus strict fsum

scope: Classical saturated submodular cover control, not a new algorithm or global oracle. No claimed approximation constant. Pooled-score feasibility only, no decode Q/K/V files read, no actual attention or generation quality guarantee, no GPU or physical capacity release. CPU cost and partial/failed cells retained.
